title: Advancements in the manufacturing routes for the synthesis of marketed PARP inhibitors
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,27593-27609
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA03016E, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Dhurgam Rani, Magdalena Plebanski, Tanmay Chatterjee
This article reviews the available literature on manufacturing routes to access the marketed PARP inhibitors, such as olaparib, rucaparib, niraparib, talazoparib, fuzuloparib, pamiparib and senaparib, since 2017.
